scope: Astra engineering selection for the paired routing study, not native encoded inputs, supplier acceptance, fabrication or powered use.

shared_choices.preferred_fast_route_face: F.Cu over uninterrupted protected GND on In1.Cu
shared_choices.role_encoding_limit: These are engineering/Quilter purposes, not literal KiCad layer-type tokens. Native canonical layer IDs, GND naming hints and detected service purposes must be reconciled during encoding/import.
shared_choices.B_surface: Contact metal, service and mechanical exclusions still apply; no extra surface freedom is inferred from layer count.

layer_roles_in_physical_order.purpose: Components, critical signals, short local power/return paths
Substantially continuous protected-GND reference; private-via guards remain
Constrained lower-speed routing and reviewed power distribution, with useful GND fill; not a blanket power plane or guaranteed B reference
Routing outside contact/service exclusions; fast routing needs separately demonstrated local reference continuity

profiles.limit: B-to-In2 spacing is small, but In2 is mixed-use rather than a guaranteed continuous ground reference. In2-to-In1 crosses the thick core.

layer_roles_in_physical_order.purpose: Components, critical signals and short local power/return paths
Additional well-referenced ordinary routing and reviewed distribution
Constrained surface routing outside exposed-contact/service exclusions

profiles.selection_reason: S/G/S/G/G/S gives three routing layers with close reference planes. Do not automatically turn both central layers into signals across their thin shared dielectric.
limits: This compares useful referenced routing capacity, not two extra signal layers or a predicted completion percentage.
Ground layers must connect to the intended functional GND network while preserving both private-via exclusions and CELL_NEG isolation.
Layer transitions require an actual nearby safe return path; plane labels alone are insufficient.
Copper balance, reference continuity and stackup-specific field geometry still require native/output and supplier review.

routing_and_via_minimum_policy.width_limit: A floor is not an ampacity or impedance specification. Retained widths stay exact; new power and impedance-sensitive routing requires its own circuit/path constraints.
routing_and_via_minimum_policy.larger_drill_rule: Copper diameter must be at least drill plus0.30mm; e.g. a0.50mm drill needs at least0.80mm copper. Do not treat independent minima as an automatically valid pair.
routing_and_via_minimum_policy.retained_vias: Preserve all18 exact geometries. Existing sizes are not resized to fit new-route defaults.

mandatory_process.required: Nonconductive resin fill, planarization and copper cap; no mask-plug/tenting substitution.

routing_and_via_minimum_policy.other_13_process_classification: The separate13-by97 screen now proves all13 off fixed lands, at unchanged0.600/0.300mm geometry and0.150mm rings. Mask/tenting/assembly and supplier treatment remain unqualified.
routing_and_via_minimum_policy.native_rule_encoding_gate: Use explicit retained-versus-new dispositions. A single global0.15mm annular minimum rejects the unchanged U4 seeds; a single smaller minimum does not enforce the new-via policy. Do not weaken output review or silently suppress inherited rule mismatches.
routing_and_via_minimum_policy.source_rule_limit: These are read-back source facts, not permission to inherit weak edge minima or silently replace the study's0.20/0.25mm requirements.

material_and_process_limits: Use the bound supplier layer rows unchanged. Their copper/dielectric sums are1.5642/1.5384mm, not guaranteed finished thickness; do not pad the values to force1.6mm.
Published nominal Dk values are3313=4.1,2116=4.16,core=4.6. Complete frequency-dependent Dk/Df, tolerances and finished thickness are not established.
POFV capability/spacing screens do not establish cap planarity or supplier acceptance of the actual complete board.
Four-layer POFV has a published additional charge; six-layer promotional inclusion is not a delivered-board/assembly quote.

USB_capability_gate.other_documented_limits: Microstrip only, no coplanar-waveguide model; pairs require recognized net classes and paired names; series resistors can split displayed pairs that are combined during compilation.
USB_capability_gate.decision: Keep the project90-ohm requirement. Do not silently substitute85 or100, mistake the serial bit rate for a qualified frequency model, or pre-route USB under the paused manual-routing policy.
USB_capability_gate.observed_UI_limit: Authenticated read-only access to completed jobs works. Opening the old job's saved comprehension URL redirects to its completed viewer; this did not expose editable impedance choices or verify current90-ohm support.
USB_capability_gate.next_required_disposition: Bounded current-capability/engineering disposition before differential-pair input release. The documentation limitation is not proof that the current UI has no additional support.
